sources.title: Unveiling the dynamic interplay between the hub- and spoke-components of the brain's semantic system and its impact on human behaviour
sources.relevance: 核心来源：直接证明 ATL hub→spoke 非对称连接（DCM定向分析，t₁₉=5.11，p<0.0001）；ATL是主动广播而非被动汇聚

sources.title: Category-specific versus category-general semantic impairment induced by transcranial magnetic stimulation
sources.authors: Pobric G, Jefferies E, Lambon Ralph MA
sources.relevance: 因果证据：ATL rTMS → 类别无关语义减慢 [t(8)=3.3, p<0.05]；IPL rTMS → 仅工具类别减慢 [t(8)=4.21, p<0.05]

sources.title: The Roles of Left Versus Right Anterior Temporal Lobes in Conceptual Knowledge: An ALE Meta-analysis of 97 Functional Neuroimaging Studies
sources.authors: Rice GE, Lambon Ralph MA, Hoffman P
sources.relevance: 元分析（97篇研究，271激活簇）：ATL 双侧激活主导；左偏向书写词汇，右偏向社会概念

sources.title: Social-semantic knowledge in frontotemporal dementia and after anterior temporal lobe resection
sources.authors: Rouse MA, Halai AD, Ramanan S, Rogers TT, Garrard P, Patterson K, Rowe JB, Lambon Ralph MA
sources.relevance: 社会性与非社会性语义损伤在双侧ATL萎缩中高度相关，无ATL不对称性效应；否定右ATL专门处理社会语义

sources.title: Map-Like Representations of an Abstract Conceptual Space in the Human Brain
sources.authors: Bokeria L, Henson RN, Mok RM
sources.relevance: 内嗅皮层六重对称概念空间导航信号；mPFC 编码类别距离；空间导航与概念学习的神经共享

sources.title: A unified neural representation model for spatial and conceptual computations
sources.authors: Haga T, Oseki Y, Fukai T
sources.relevance: DSI 统一模型：后继者表征 ≡ 逐点互信息（数学等价）；网格细胞=概念细胞的空间类比；词语类比与空间三角推断共享同一运算

sources.title: A unified model of human semantic knowledge and its disorders
sources.authors: Chen L, Lambon Ralph MA, Rogers TT
sources.relevance: C3（连接约束认知）计算模型：ATL枢纽损伤→跨类别损伤；类别特异性是学习+连接的涌现属性；模拟4类神经损伤患者模式

sources.title: Concept cells: the building blocks of declarative memory functions
sources.relevance: 概念细胞综述：内侧颞叶稀疏抽象跨模态概念响应神经元，为情节记忆提供概念身份锚点

sources.relevance: 内嗅皮层六重旋转对称信号编码视觉空间维度（非物理导航），支持网格样编码的跨域普遍性
